subject: [hw] opus-kern: q10jw image (supersedes q10jv) + where GCE lists run
body: q10jw: gpu/build/device-mmu-q10jw-candidate/ui-sched/nord2-ios-metal-q10jw-ui654fb60dvfs-cap3500-ram3776-sched.img sha256 8882a84a...93db38d, kernel d887dc6a...55a63a, FAILURES none, boot spare 10240 B. Inputs unchanged (K02 a939f107, IK a2e90ed5, K01 b57f87f9) + 0311 knob: autotest command 8 step 1 arg bit 9 (hwv.py --slow) sets venc_sel to mainpll_d4_d2 = 273 MHz (mmdvfs venc_step3, lowest vcore OPP) while VEN is off; the driver keeps it. Tests: N2TEST P031X PASS 588971/588971. GCE: the library emits struct gce_cmds (not raw GCE instructions); V40 vcu/n2vcu.c gce_run_list() turns them into RWVC_REGS / RWVC_WAIT_IRQ / pool copies (tested in vcu/test_v40/t_v40.c); the kernel needs no GCE parser. opus-venc section 6 list is satisfied: windows 0x3000 (>= 0x1300 used), polled +0x5c wait with ack +0x60 (double ack harmless), PAs page-aligned < 4 GB, IOMMU bypass + no MMSRAM on all 17 VENC ports (larb-port.h:91-141 answers section 7 item 2). hw-ip/V40: power VEN around each job (no power IPI in GCE mode) and slbc_ready = 0.
